capability: Same parts, any grouping, same whole (engine only)
title: Draw the sockets first.

hook.picture: Close on the whale rebuilding the right half of a small tree of grey cards hanging from the line.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We reran one step and got a different result.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: grey cards loosely stacked with no visible joins. Three reruns, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each makes a different result card.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nobody wrote down how the steps joined.

stakes.body: Results cannot be reproduced, so every rerun costs a full rebuild and a week of doubt.

solution_hint: Draw each step with its sockets.

metaphor.body: Each step is a card with sockets and wires, like a circuit drawing; because the wires say exactly how steps join, joining left-first or right-first gives the same tree, and any branch can be rebuilt alone.

steps.picture: Each grey card grows input sockets on its left and an output socket on its right; wires join them.
The tree is now a clean drawing of cards and wires.
steps.words: Each step: a card, its sockets, its wires.

steps.picture: Two assembly orders play side by side, left pair first and right pair first, and morph into one identical tree.
steps.sound: Two phrases that land on the same note

steps.picture: Push-in: only the right branch is rebuilt from its saved inputs; the new root card matches yesterday's and gets a teal tick.
steps.words: Join them in any order. Same tree.

steps.picture: Every card's output drops a small tick: saved.

real_case.claim: Operad of design units, Law 2: "Associativity = recomputability. Every colour is a file; any subtree re-runs from its inputs." (manutej/discopy itself could not be read; not used as a source.)

source.title: The operad of design units (GenUI Studio Research Wiki)

honest_limit.picture: A pod card (an AI step) sits inside the tree. The two assembly orders play again; this time they end in two different root cards, one rust.
honest_limit.words: Add an AI step. The orders disagree.

not_this.body: The joins regroup. AI answers don't.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the two result cards side by side, as in bar 2. They slide together and become one identical card with a teal tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The mismatched pair of result cards from bar 2 merge into one, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Save each step's inputs. Rerun only what changed.

score_self.reason: The regroup picture is elegant for researchers and the limit (AI steps do not regroup) is honest and visual. The repo could not be read, so the case leans on the design wiki, and reproducibility pain is narrower.
